channel.title: The Journal · Dr. Susan Besman
channel.description: Articles on divorce recovery, midlife identity, and rebuilding your life, from psychotherapist Dr. Susan Besman, Ph.D., LMFT.

item.title: Co-Parenting After a Hard Divorce: How to Protect Your Children (and Your Peace)
item.dc:creator: Dr. Susan Besman, Ph.D., LMFT
item.description: You don't have to like your former spouse to co-parent well. A Boca Raton therapist shares practical ways to keep conflict away from your children and protect your own peace.

item.title: Gray Divorce: Starting Over After a Long Marriage
item.dc:creator: Dr. Susan Besman, Ph.D., LMFT
item.description: Divorce after 50 and after decades together brings its own grief, money worries and identity questions. A Boca Raton therapist shares gentle, practical steps for starting over.

item.title: How to Rebuild Your Life After Divorce at 50: Where to Start
item.dc:creator: Dr. Susan Besman, Ph.D., LMFT
item.description: A Boca Raton therapist who rebuilt after her own divorce shares practical first steps for women navigating divorce in midlife.

item.title: “Who Am I Now?” Rediscovering Your Identity in Midlife
item.dc:creator: Dr. Susan Besman, Ph.D., LMFT
item.description: Why so many women feel lost in midlife, and practical ways to rediscover who you are after divorce, an empty nest, or a career change.

item.title: Strength Training for Women Over 50: Why Muscle Matters More Than Ever
item.dc:creator: Dr. Susan Besman, Ph.D., LMFT
item.description: Why strength training is one of the best things women can do for their health and confidence after 50, and how to start safely.
